name: Sarawak Children's Cancer Society (SCCS)
summary: Supports children with cancer in Sarawak and their families with practical, financial and emotional help, so no child faces cancer alone.
programmes: Counselling, buddy programme and palliative-care home visits
Two halfway homes for families travelling for treatment
Subsidies for drugs, procedures, lab tests and equipment
Awareness and training for healthcare providers
Recreation and family activities; GoBald fundraising campaign
impact: About 1,800 families supported across Sarawak over 25 years (Borneo Post, 28 Mar 2026)
Over RM14 million raised through GoBald since 2009 (Borneo Post, 28 Mar 2026)
41 families stayed at the Halfway Home in 2025 (website)
beneficiaries: Children with cancer in Sarawak and their families
